title: The parade · robots and animals on the line

reference.grammar: A line of robots, dogs, a cat and a hen walking one ground line, each drawn flat with a soft shadow.

techniques.name: Robot parade

count.label: Walkers
count.note: How many figures walk the line, from the head of the parade back. The whole line always fits the strip, so a longer line draws smaller.

company.label: Company
company.note: Whether the hound, the hen and the Siamese walk with the robots.

spacing.label: Spacing
spacing.note: Gap between one walker and the next, against their height. A closer line draws larger.

spread.label: Size spread
spread.note: How much the robots differ in height. 0 makes them one size; 1 is the page’s spread.

stride.label: Stride
stride.note: How far each leg swings, as a share of the page’s walk. 0 stands the line still.

shadow.label: Shadow length
shadow.note: How far each cast shadow reaches behind its walker. 1 is the page’s low sun.

techniques.implementation: A character is drawn as a set of states around an idle hub and placed into scenes. Drawn by the source page’s own code: the robot is the brand character (the logomark head on a small body) in its seven colorways, walking with a hound, a hen and a Siamese.

techniques.name: Measured inks
techniques.implementation: solid ink pixels of each figure, read at full resolution, are clustered to five colors; a color is kept when it holds at least 4% of the ink.

techniques.name: Figure and ground
techniques.implementation: The ground is the most common border color of a figure; ink is every pixel more than 40 levels from it.

pass_order: walkers · each placed by the clock, drawn from its own walk cycle
